siteSettings.title: English Adventures: Everyone vs Every One

modules.name: Learn
modules.title: Pronouns & Determiners Lessons
modules.instructions: Master the difference between EVERYONE (collective pronoun) and EVERY ONE (determiner phrase). Learn when to use each form.

modules.name: Write
modules.title: Writing Practice
modules.instructions: Write sentences using EVERYONE and EVERY ONE correctly. Practice with collective vs individual meanings.

modules.name: Play
modules.title: Grammar Games
modules.instructions: Play games to practice choosing between EVERYONE and EVERY ONE based on meaning and context.

modules.name: Quiz
modules.title: Quick Quiz
modules.instructions: Test your knowledge with multiple choice questions about pronouns vs determiners. Choose the correct form!

modules.name: Apply
modules.title: Pronouns Challenge
modules.instructions: Apply EVERYONE and EVERY ONE correctly in sentences. Master collective vs individual distinctions.
